text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, to put artificial nails over 
claws that were in this kind of state...

The crack in Tosen Jordan's hoof went 
deep, discolored to a dark, reddish-black.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can run!! I can definitely 
run!!”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Even if it's just a nail, please do not 
take it lightly.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Every time you Umamusume race, the strain 
placed on your legs is incomparably 
greater than anything we humans 
experience.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much the ball of your foot 
absorbs the impact from the ground, the 
strain on your toes... your nails is still 
immense.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still, if I tape it up...!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
What if pushing yourself lets bacteria in? 
What if favoring your foot makes you 
injure another part of your body?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In truth, you experienced pain that was 
truly unbearable this time, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
With just a single choice, you could throw 
away the rest of your life, you know.

I pick up the medicine prescribed just in 
case and leave the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm running in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've made up my mind! I don't 
care what happens after! I am definitely 
running in the Satsuki Sho!!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise... I quit! If I can't run, I'm 
retiring right now!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Because! This is a once-in-a-lifetime 
chance, you know?! And giving up on it 
because of my hoof again is just... 
gah...!"

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Jordan, your nail again...? ...Then I 
guess we'll have to sit out the next 
selection race too.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. If you put in the 
effort, I'm sure you can catch right up to 
your peers, starting now—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, my hoof split again. Did too much 
running this time around...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, won't you tell Sensei? Like, what 
you really want to talk about... okay?"

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
It seems Jordan-san cracked a nail again. 
Yes, indeed... Under these circumstances, 
it's hard to recommend her for the 
selection races.

text_block_list.name: Instructor B
text_block_list.text:
That's true... This injury was 
self-reported again, right? Given the 
rumors, whether the injury itself is even 
real or not...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. *sigh*... If she didn't 
feel like running, I could have handled it 
if she had just talked to me properly...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I... I...! I don't want to lose any more 
races!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I've always sucked at studying! And I'm 
clumsy! My teachers yell at me all the 
time, too! But still!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I finally won, won, and kept 
on winning... I'd become someone 
incredible...! And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Her hooves took everything, everything 
from her...! To think she can't even run 
the Classics...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My dream isn't coming true at all...! If I 
stay like this, I'll...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No, stop it...!! I don't want this...!

"...Her eyes were welling up with tears... 
with frustration on the verge of spilling 
over."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I can do this! A little pain like this is 
nothing...!

Even if she were to run through her 
injury, it would only shorten her racing 
career.

However, if I rob her of the option called 
"possibility" before that, her spirit will 
surely break. If so—

"At the very least, we'll need to take 
even more meticulous care of her hooves. 
I'll also see if we can improve her 
horseshoes to suit her better."

Putting her legs first... And on top of 
that, we will continue training to win.
choice_data_list:
You won't have any time left to play, you 
know.
You won't have any time left to play.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list:
Do you have the resolve to stake 
everything on the race?

Are you ready to put everything on the 
line for the race?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I do. Obviously.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna be big too! I just have to run 
in it!"
choice_data_list:
Next time it hurts, please tell me right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for keeping quiet until now.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text: "A-Are you alright?! Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... What a relief~. Though with 
an injury that severe, the Satsuki Sho is 
probably out of the—

I beg the reporter not to write an article 
about what they saw during today's 
training.

"I want to prevent unwarranted commotion 
sparked by unsettling articles before the 
Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...Does that mean... you're forcing an 
Umamusume who's suffering from an injury 
to run in a race?"

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"We cannot... accept that. We are 
journalists as well. If you intend to 
force our hand, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No! He would never do that! He promised 
he'd fix his claws, too!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So please... I'm begging you! For the sake 
of my Satsuki Sho... please help me...!!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I will keep it strictly to 
myself for now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: Let's do our best from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you, Trainer.

From that day on, the daily routine of 
conditioning and caring for her legs 
leading up to the Satsuki Sho began—
